keys.description: How long a daemon runs without a request before it stops.
keys.type: duration, such as 10m (units s, m, h, d)

keys.description: Generated or vendored files, which edits refuse to change without --allow generated: paths or gitignore-style patterns, relative to the root.
keys.type: comma-separated directories, relative to the project root

keys.description: Files larger than this are skipped.
keys.type: size, such as 2MB (units B, KB, MB, GB; 1 KB = 1024 B)

keys.description: How often a running daemon rescans the whole project, catching changes the watcher missed.
keys.type: duration, such as 10m (units s, m, h, d)

keys.description: Language of the files matching each glob, overriding detection.
keys.type: language, one of: c, cpp, csharp, go, java, javascript, json, kotlin, markdown, php, python, ruby, rust, sql, text, toml, tsx, typescript, xml, yaml

keys.description: How long a preview can be applied after it is planned.
keys.type: duration, such as 10m (units s, m, h, d)

keys.description: Source directories, overriding those found from build files.
keys.type: comma-separated directories, relative to the project root
